sub_graphs.title: Prague: Transaction Validation Exception Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models the exception types and error conditions during transaction validation in Prague fork

nodes.label: Transaction Received for Validation
nodes.description: System state when a transaction has been received and awaits validation

nodes.label: Validate Transaction Type
nodes.description: Check if the transaction type byte (EIP-2718) is a known and valid type

nodes.label: Transaction Type Error Raised
nodes.description: System rejects transaction due to unknown EIP-2718 transaction type byte

nodes.label: Validate Contract Creation Allowed
nodes.description: Check if the transaction type permits contract creation (to=None)

nodes.label: Contract Creation Disallowed Error
nodes.description: System rejects transaction because this type disallows contract creation

nodes.label: Validate Fee Structure
nodes.description: Verify maxFeePerGas and maxPriorityFeePerGas relationship and sufficiency

nodes.label: Insufficient Max Fee Error
nodes.description: Transaction rejected because maxFeePerGas is less than block baseFeePerGas

nodes.label: Priority Fee Greater Than Max Fee Error
nodes.description: Transaction rejected because maxPriorityFeePerGas exceeds maxFeePerGas

nodes.label: Transaction Passed Validation
nodes.description: Transaction has passed all validation checks

edges.label: Transaction type recognized, check contract creation
Contract creation allowed or not attempted

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External entity submitting transactions for validation

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Blob Transaction Validation Exceptions
sub_graphs.description: Models exception handling specific to EIP-4844 blob transactions

nodes.label: Blob Transaction Received
nodes.description: System state when a type-3 (blob) transaction is received for validation

nodes.label: Validate Blob Gas Limit
nodes.description: Check if blob gas usage does not exceed the maximum allowed per block

nodes.label: Blob Gas Limit Exceeded Error
nodes.description: Transaction rejected because blob gas exceeds maximum allowed

nodes.label: Validate Blob Fee Sufficiency
nodes.description: Verify maxFeePerBlobGas is sufficient for current blob base fee

nodes.label: Insufficient Blob Fee Error
nodes.description: Transaction rejected because maxFeePerBlobGas is too low

nodes.label: Validate Blob Versioned Hashes
nodes.description: Verify blob versioned hashes have correct version prefix

nodes.label: Invalid Blob Versioned Hash Error
nodes.description: Transaction rejected due to invalid blob versioned hash format

nodes.label: Validate Blob Data Present
nodes.description: Ensure blob transaction contains at least one blob

nodes.label: No Blob Data Error
nodes.description: Transaction rejected because it lacks required blob data

nodes.label: Blob Transaction Validated
nodes.description: Blob transaction has passed all blob-specific validation checks

edges.label: Versioned hash has invalid version byte
Versioned hashes valid, check gas limit
Blob gas within limits, check fee

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Init Code Size Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models error handling for contract initialization code size limits

nodes.label: Contract Creation Initiated
nodes.description: System state when a contract creation transaction or CREATE opcode is being processed

nodes.label: Validate Init Code Size
nodes.description: Check if initialization code size is within allowed limits

nodes.label: Init Code Too Large Error
nodes.description: Contract creation rejected because init code exceeds maximum size

nodes.label: Init Code Size Valid
nodes.description: Init code is within size limits, can proceed with execution

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Authorization List Validation (EIP-7702)
sub_graphs.description: Models validation of authorization lists for account abstraction transactions

nodes.label: Authorization Transaction Received
nodes.description: System state when a transaction with authorization list is received

nodes.label: Validate Authorization List
nodes.description: Check that the authorization list is non-empty

nodes.label: Empty Authorization List Error
nodes.description: Transaction rejected because authorization list is empty

nodes.label: Authorization List Valid
nodes.description: Authorization list passes basic validation

ambiguities.text: The relationship between transaction type errors and specific type bytes is not fully enumerated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume valid types are 0 (legacy), 1 (EIP-2930), 2 (EIP-1559), 3 (EIP-4844), and 4 (EIP-7702). Any other byte triggers TransactionTypeError.

ambiguities.text: The exact conditions for when TransactionTypeContractCreationError is raised are not explicit
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume blob transactions (type 3) cannot create contracts. Type 4 authorization transactions may also have restrictions.

implicit_assumptions.description: Exception handlers are assumed to be invoked correctly and not bypassed
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Invalid transactions could be processed without proper rejection

implicit_assumptions.description: The block base fee is correctly propagated from the parent block header
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Fee validation could accept transactions with insufficient fees or reject valid ones
